parameters.content:
## HOW TO USE

**1.** Create a Google Sheet with these headers in row 1:

Video URL | Status | Title | Markdown File | Processed At | Notes

Type them into six separate cells. Pasting them as one tab-separated string puts them all in A1 and the workflow will silently do nothing.

**2.** Create a Google Drive folder for the .md files.

**3.** Open the **Settings** node and paste your youtube-transcript.io API token and the Drive folder ID.

**4.** Put your Sheet URL on the trigger, **Mark Row Done** and **Mark Row Failed**.

**5.** Pick your Google credential on all four Google nodes, then activate.

Paste a YouTube link into the **Video URL** column.
Within a minute you get a .md file in Drive and the row is marked Done.

parameters.content:
## The happy path

New row -> check it is a YouTube link -> pull the video ID -> fetch the transcript -> clean it -> write a .md file -> save to Drive -> mark the row Done.

The .md file has a header block (title, source link, word count) then the transcript in paragraphs, ready to hand straight to Claude.

## When it fails

Nothing stops silently. Every failure writes **Failed** plus the reason into the same row of your sheet:

- no captions on the video
- out of API credits
- bad token or a service error

Fix the cause, then clear the Status cell and paste the link into a fresh row.
